heading: Supersedure lookup — always O(1)
text:
### Supersedure lookup — always O(1) [LNLS.5.3]

The supersedure lookup of [LNLS.4.7] is O(1) amortized for every schema a
`linear_scan: false` program declares: keyed on the declared key, or, for a schema
whose key is empty, over at most one live fact. Removing the superseded fact
from working memory costs what the same clause bounds removal at.
